text: Testing is a crucial part of software development. There are different types of tests, each serving a specific purpose. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like individual functions, to ensure they work correctly on their own. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of the system work well together when combined. A popular approach is test-driven development, or TDD, where you write a failing test first, then write just enough code to make it pass, and finally improve the code. Although testing takes time, it builds confidence. Knowing your code is protected by tests means you can make changes more easily, without fear of breaking something hidden.
